messages:
Maria P: Kickoff — we need a quick alignment for the cloud marketplace listing handoff. Focus: SKU mapping, trial entitlements, and legal sign-off. I uploaded the vendor pack: https://drive.redwood/example-pack 
Drew L: Thanks. Can someone confirm whether we require a modified publisher agreement for Azure? Also EU data residency clause — is that in scope for this initial listing?
Sam K: Product here — propose two SKUs: 
1) Standard (shared infra, API access)
2) Enterprise (dedicated infra, SSO + custom entitlements).
Trial: 14 days. Pricing: monthly + annual committed options.
Neha R: From infra ops: Enterprise SKU needs a separate onboarding flow (billing account mapping + dedicated subnet). We should add that to the listing notes.
Priya S: Legal: Azure typically wants the publisher agreement, EULA, and tax docs. If Enterprise touches customer VPC/on-prem connectors, we may need a CA (confidentiality addendum). Drew — can you confirm timeline?
Drew L: I can review the publisher agreement template by Thu. For CA: need product spec confirming no access to customer data unless explicitly opted-in. If Enterprise includes managed services, expect a short SOW.
Maria P: Cool. Let's capture a minimal checklist so ops/sales knows what's required. Putting a quick draft below:
```
- SKUs: standard, enterprise, dev
- Trial length: 14d (auto-convert to trial license)
- Pricing tiers: monthly/annual; list price + discounted commit
- Required legal: publisher agreement, EULA, tax forms, CA if managed service
- Assets: logo (512x512), product screenshots, 1-page quickstart, listing copy
- IAM: publisher account, billing contact, support alias
- EU note: data residency statement for EU customers (Azure: EU region mapping)
- Onboarding hooks: provisioning webhook + entitlement callback (test sandbox)
```
Sam K: A few notes on the listing copy: call out dedicated gateway for Enterprise, list latency expectations, and add a short troubleshooting section. I'll draft copy by Wed.
Neha R: Ops: we need a test tenant created in each cloud marketplace sandbox. ops-bot — can you provision?
ops-bot: Created marketplace test tenants: AWS-sandbox-01, GCP-sandbox-01, Azure-sandbox-01. Drive folder: https://drive.redwood/marketplace-sandbox (permissions: partnerships + eng).
Priya S: FYI — for GCP there is a separate tax onboarding flow; vendor should complete Payout/Tax form before publication. I'll add a tracker.
Maria P: Thanks — action items:
- Drew: legal review by Thu (publisher + CA ask)
- Sam: listing copy + SKU descriptions by Wed
- Neha: confirm provisioning APIs + callback endpoints by Fri
- Priya: tax/payout checklist added to tracker
- Maria: consolidate assets and submit to AWS/GCP/Azure portals next Mon
Drew L: :thumbsup:
Sam K: will sync with marketing for screenshots
Neha R: I'll run a smoke test on the webhook once endpoints are up
Maria P: If anyone hits blockers, drop here and I'll escalate to vendor ops. Thanks everyone!
